name: Raised ground
movement: Heights 0 to 3; climbing a level needs a ramp, stairs, vines or a leap
sight: Guards on higher ground see 2 tiles further per level
with_laws: Half gravity turns one-level climbs into leaps

name: Ramp
with_laws: Tilt makes ramps fast one way and slow the other

name: Stairs
movement: Climb one level 20% faster than a ramp
sight: Footsteps on stairs carry 1 tile further
with_laws: Leapfrog skips whole flights

name: Cliff edge
movement: Blocks climbing; dropping down is free and one-way
sight: Guards can't see the foot of their own cliff
with_laws: Honeycomb lets anyone climb it

name: Pit
movement: Drops anyone to the level below
with_laws: Heavy ground makes loot dropped near a pit roll in

name: Arch
with_laws: Glass makes arches see-through

name: Tunnel
movement: A hidden path joining two points up to 6 tiles apart
with_laws: Glowing dark makes tunnel mouths glow

name: Stepping stones
with_laws: Half gravity or a Featherkin makes them a road

name: Stream
with_laws: Slow rivers makes it a barrier; Spores can put waders to sleep

name: Pond
movement: Deep: only swimmers cross; everyone else goes round
with_laws: Frictionless freezes nothing; Held breath stills the ripples

name: Marsh
with_laws: Haunting trails are easier to follow

name: Waterfall
movement: Walk behind it on a hidden ledge
with_laws: Tidemark pulls the water back up at each return

name: Rapids
movement: Pushes anyone 1 tile a second downstream
with_laws: Current adds to or fights the push

name: Ice sheet
with_laws: Frictionless on ice sends sliders twice as far

name: Hot spring
movement: Heals 2% health a second while standing in it, for both sides
sight: Steam hides anyone inside beyond 2 tiles
with_laws: Regrowth doubles the healing

name: Tall grass
sight: Hides anyone inside from guards more than 2 tiles away
with_laws: Glowing dark makes it almost impossible to watch

name: Bush
with_laws: Stillness makes a bush a perfect hiding place

name: Hedge
with_laws: Bloom regrows it; Thorns makes it hurt

name: Tree
with_laws: Current makes trees sway and cones flicker

name: Flower meadow
with_laws: Wild paths grows faster here

name: Thicket
with_laws: Spores clouds linger longer inside

name: Climbing vines
movement: Climb one level without a ramp
with_laws: Honeycomb and vines together let anyone scale any cliff

name: Bounce mushroom
sight: The landing can be heard 4 tiles away
with_laws: Half gravity makes it 5 tiles

name: Boulder
movement: Blocks; a Breaker smashes it in about 6 seconds
with_laws: Brittle stone halves the time

name: Gravel path
with_laws: Wild paths flowers grow here first

name: Scree
with_laws: Tilt makes scree slide downhill

name: Rock pillar
with_laws: Bounce makes pillars fling people back

name: Crystal outcrop
sight: See-through; bends light, so lanterns reach 2 tiles further past it
with_laws: Crystal growth spreads outcrops

name: Lantern post
sight: Lights 3 tiles: nothing hides inside the light
with_laws: Soul lanterns makes lanterns safe ground

name: Shade canopy
sight: Hides anyone beyond 3 tiles; blocks Sunburst
with_laws: Sunburst makes shade precious

name: Fog bank
sight: Hides anyone inside and blocks sight through it
with_laws: Aurora bands light fog from inside

name: Updraft vent
movement: Lifts anyone one level; flyers two
with_laws: Half gravity sends people two levels

name: Ember vent
movement: Bursts of flame every 8 seconds; hurts anyone on it
with_laws: Heat bloom powers up anyone nearby

name: Lava crack
with_laws: Leaps clear it under Half gravity

name: Static stone
movement: Zaps anyone within 1 tile every 4 seconds
with_laws: Static and Chain lightning make it a trap

name: Fence
with_laws: Leapfrog clears fences

name: Statue
with_laws: Borrowed Face statues look like guards

name: Ruin wall
with_laws: Shifting stones moves ruin walls too

name: Bell post
sight: Raises the realm's alarm one level (12.17)
with_laws: Delay makes the ring come late
